## v0.6.1

### Source control sidebar stays in sync

The sidebar no longer needs the refresh button.

- **Fetch, push, stash and merge/rebase state** now update live. The file watcher covers `.git/refs` (remotes, stash, tags), `packed-refs` and merge/rebase markers. Before, only `HEAD`, `index` and local branches were watched, so ahead/behind counts, stashes and in-progress states went stale.
- **No more self-triggered refreshes.** Read-only git calls run with `GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0`, so `git status` stops rewriting `.git/index` and no longer contends for `index.lock` with commands you run yourself.
- **Dropped watcher events** (Windows buffer overflow) now trigger a full refresh instead of being ignored.
- **Failed status fetches retry** instead of leaving stale data. The sidebar also resyncs on WebSocket reconnect and window focus.
- **Branches and graph refetch** when ahead/behind changes.

### Faster updates

File change to sidebar update latency drops from about 340 ms to about 160 ms of debounce time. Backend debounce is 120 ms (was 260 ms), max batch 400 ms (was 600 ms), and the frontend flush is 40 ms (was 80 ms).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Cosmos-0118/vireo/compare/v0.6.0...v0.6.1
